people.name: Baanah
people.line: A captain who murdered Ish-bosheth, Saul's son.

people.name: Beeroth
people.line: Hivite city, later allotted to Benjamin.

people.name: Ish-bosheth
people.line: Son of Saul, king over Israel.

people.name: Rechab
people.line: A captain of Ishbosheth's army, with his brother Baanah

people.name: Rimmon
people.line: Father of Baanah and Rechab, murderers of Ish-bosheth

translations.web: The sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, Rechab and Baanah, went and came at about the heat of the day to the house of Ishbosheth, as he took his rest at noon.
translations.bsb: Now Rechab and Baanah, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, set out and arrived at the house of Ish-bosheth in the heat of the day, while the king was taking his midday nap.
translations.kjv: And the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, Rechab and Baanah, went, and came about the heat of the day to the house of Ishbosheth, who lay on a bed at noon.
translations.asv: And the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, Rechab and Baanah, went, and came about the heat of the day to the house of Ish-bosheth, as he took his rest at noon.
